name: save-boot-16a-mktinn-talk-ranges
description: #168 fresh budget, attempt 1 (diagnostic). Boot harness/saves/disc1-mktinn.json (Wall Market's inn, field 199) and load as save-boot-1-load does, then 60 still frames. For models 1-4: the talk-distance sign from the player (n1..n4: sign of floor(hypot(dx, dy)) - (TalkRange + the player's SolidRange), in field units, -1 within range), and self, the same check of the player against itself with its own SolidRange (must be -1: distance 0; checks the near check's wiring). Only frame counts and signs leave.
